title: A constructed cohort with the same mean of 142 mg/dL and two humps
alt: Histogram of a constructed 60-person cohort with two separate humps and a near-empty gap at the mean of 142 mg/dL.
longDescription: This is not the study cohort. It is a constructed set of 60 values with exactly the same mean, 142 mg/dL, arranged in the same nine bins 10 mg/dL wide. Reading from the left, the counts are 2 people from 95 to 105 mg/dL, 8 from 105 to 115, 12 from 115 to 125, 6 from 125 to 135, 2 from 135 to 145, 4 from 145 to 155, 12 from 155 to 165, 10 from 165 to 175, and 4 from 175 to 185. There are two humps, one near 120 mg/dL and one near 160, with a near-empty gap between them. The mean of 142 mg/dL, marked by a vertical line, falls inside that gap: only 2 of the 60 people sit in the bin containing it. The mean is arithmetically correct and describes almost nobody in the group.
